name: unknown-signal-classification
description: Classify unidentified signals in a bus capture by correlating them with known physical quantities, timing patterns, and system events. Produces a classification for each unknown and a capture plan for the remainder.

config.instruction: Extract all unidentified message IDs. Profile each with rate, DLC, byte-level entropy, and rate-tier classification.
Cross-correlate every unknown byte pattern against all known signals. Identify mirrors (r > 0.90) and infer encoding by least-squares fit.
Correlate remaining unknowns with labeled system events. Classify by associated subsystem (brake, steering, powertrain, etc.).
Design the minimal set of single-action captures to close the remaining opaque signals. Order by expected resolution count.
